# 44 Physiques

> Precision physique and contest prep coaching for bodybuilding, bikini, physique, and figure competitors plus driven non-competitors. Fully online nutrition, training, posing, and weekly check-in coaching, with in-person posing available in Florida.

44 Physiques is an online physique coaching business. Every plan — nutrition, training, cardio, posing, and peak week — is custom-built around the individual client's body, goals, schedule, and physique response. Coaching is delivered fully online worldwide, with optional in-person posing for Florida-based athletes.

## Business Details

- Business name: 44 Physiques
- Tagline: Chase the Physique
- Website: https://team44physiques.com/

- Instagram (team): https://instagram.com/team44physiques
- Service area: Online / worldwide (in-person posing available in Florida, United States)

## Coaching Services

- Online Coaching & Nutrition — fully personalized remote training and nutrition with weekly check-ins and real-time adjustments.
- Contest Prep — show-date-driven nutrition, training, cardio, and posing for bodybuilding, bikini, physique, and figure competitors. Page: https://team44physiques.com/services/contest-prep/
- Rush Prep — emergency flat-rate prep for competitors 4–5 weeks out from a show. Page: https://team44physiques.com/services/rush-prep/
- Offseason Prep — structured muscle-building programming to maximize size while managing body fat between shows. Page: https://team44physiques.com/services/offseason-prep/
- Lifestyle Coaching — sustainable body composition, health, and habit coaching for non-competitors. Page: https://team44physiques.com/services/lifestyle-coaching/
- Posing Coaching — stage presentation coaching via FaceTime (remote) or in-person (Florida). Page: https://team44physiques.com/services/posing-coaching/

## Pricing

- Contest Prep: $275/month USD. Minimum 3 months ($825). 6 months: $1,650. 12 months: $3,300.
- Rush Prep: $425 USD flat rate, paid in full. For competitors 4–5 weeks out from a show.
- Lifestyle Coaching: $250/month USD. Minimum 3 months ($750). 6 months: $1,500. 12 months: $3,000.
- Offseason Prep & Online Coaching & Nutrition: priced per program — submit the inquiry form for a quote.

## Contract Minimums

- Contest Prep: 3-month minimum commitment.
- Lifestyle Coaching: 3-month minimum commitment.
- Rush Prep: single 4–5 week engagement, paid in full upfront.

## Included In Every Package

- Custom training program built around your split, volume tolerance, weak points, and recovery.
- Personalized nutrition plan dialed to your body, goals, and eating habits.
- Weekly check-ins with real-time nutrition and training adjustments.
- Peak week guidance (water, sodium, carbs, training, posing) into show day.
- Contest Prep and Rush Prep additionally include 2 posing sessions per month and a supplementation guide.

## Online & In-Person Availability

- All coaching (nutrition, training, weekly check-ins) is delivered fully online and is available regardless of location.
- Posing is available via FaceTime for remote clients, or in-person for clients located in Florida, United States.

## Weekly Check-In Process

- Each week the client submits front and back posing photos taken in good lighting, plus progress data.
- The coach reviews photos and data and adjusts nutrition and training in real time based on physique response.
- Diet and workout adjustments are made weekly from check-in data; workouts are customized to body-part weaknesses and strengths.

## Peak Week Guidance

- Water, sodium, carbohydrates, training, and posing are walked through day by day leading into show day for Contest Prep and Rush Prep clients.
